key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week on rate-rise fears and oil price surge, with miners and banks leading the decline
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern
Oil prices surged as suppression efforts failed, raising fuel costs by ~30c/L and inflation risk
ANZ.AX restructuring (3,500 job cuts) signals ongoing pressure on financials sector
Housing market correction deepens: no spring bounce at auctions, first-home buyers surging on falling prices
Mining cap raises accelerating (Canaccord-led), signalling capital stress in junior miners
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy security fears; Santos preservation noted

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; large-cap miners (BHP, RIO, FMG) under pressure. Junior miners raising capital (Canaccord-led dash) amid weak commodity backdrop. Small-cap exceptions: PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Cap raises dilute equity holders in juniors. Selective opportunities in critical minerals (battery tech – Critical Resources) and gold (despite 'schmould' commentary, safe-haven bid persists).

sectors.trend: Negative. Banks leading ASX decline alongside miners. ANZ.AX executing 3,500-job restructuring with 'long way to go' on transformation. Rising bond yields and rate-rise fears pressure net interest margins and credit growth.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face headwinds from slower credit growth and elevated funding costs. ANZ restructuring may improve medium-term efficiency but near-term execution risk is high.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive for producers. Oil surge (suppression failure) lifts Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, Origin.AX. Australia softened gas supply rules, easing Asian demand fears. Fuel price rise (+30c/L) supports upstream but pressures downstream/consumer.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX and Woodside.AX benefit from oil/gas price strength. Consumer energy costs rising, pressuring WES.AX, WTW.AX margins. Gas supply rule changes reduce export restriction risk.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths.AX breached its own 'Price Freeze' on four staples, eroding consumer trust. Housing correction accelerates (no auction bounce, first-home buyer surge). Business confidence deteriorating.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin pressure from input costs vs. pricing power limits. REITs (GPG.AX, SPG.AX) pressured by rental inflation concerns and falling property values. Consumer discretionary at risk.

sectors.trend: Neutral-to-positive. Gilead US ruling (HIV drug import block) supports CSL.AX-adjacent IP moats. AI development slowdown calls from tech execs create uncertainty. ASX small-caps (Neurizon, Iondrive) showing momentum.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX remain defensive anchors. AI slowdown narrative may pressure global tech but limited direct ASX impact. Small-cap tech/biotech speculative activity continues.

key_themes: Rate-rise fears and RBA rental inflation concern driving bond yield spike and equity de-rating
Commodity bifurcation: oil surging while iron ore bleeds – mixed for diversified miners
AUD weakness amplifies import costs and inflation risk, complicating RBA path
Housing correction maturing: falling prices, rising first-home buyer activity, no auction recovery
Mining sector capital stress: cap raises signal cash burn in juniors
Superannuation policy debate intensifying (populism vs. system integrity)
Energy security: Australia easing gas rules, Santos preservation as strategic priority

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / hawkish pivot on rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour floating-rate and energy-linked equities; hedge with AUD short if growth scare persists

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse / China demand weakness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and critical minerals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price surge driving inflation and fuel cost shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour upstream energy (SOS.AX, WDS.AX); avoid transport and consumer discretionary; monitor fuel price pass-through
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented and domestic-revenue companies; monitor RBA intervention signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction spilling into credit losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NIM and credit provisions; underweight REITs; favour defensive consumer staples with pricing power

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining cap raise dilution / capital stress in juniors
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid dilutive cap raises; focus on cash-flow-positive juniors or large-cap miners with strong balance sheets

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight upstream energy on oil/gas price surge and eased gas supply rules
opportunities.rationale: Oil suppression failure and softened gas export rules create tailwind for Australian producers; fuel cost pass-through supports margins

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and critical minerals as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting diverts capital to safe-haven (gold) and structural-demand (battery tech, critical minerals) plays

opportunities.recommendation: Selective first-home buyer / construction plays on housing correction
opportunities.rationale: Falling prices and surging first-home buyer activity support volume-driven builders and mortgage brokers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce large-cap iron ore exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in active decline phase; cap raises in juniors signal sector-wide stress; China demand uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight banks pending ANZ restructuring clarity and credit cycle
defensive_moves.rationale: 3,500-job cuts at ANZ signal structural pressure; rising yields and housing correction threaten NIM and credit quality

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and rate risk; favour defensive consumer staples
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD weakness and inflation risk from oil/fuel surge; WES/WTW pricing power limited but defensive relative to cyclicals

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower on rate-rise fears, iron ore weakness, and oil-driven inflation. RBA rental inflation commentary may trigger hawkish repricing. Expect volatility in miners and banks. Energy names outperform. AUD remains under pressure.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction nearing maturity with first-home buyer surge. Energy transition (critical minerals, battery tech) offers structural growth. Superannuation system reform debate may create policy tailwinds. Iron ore recovery contingent on China stimulus. RBA likely to hold or hike once, then pivot.
key_catalysts: RBA statement on rental inflation and rate path
Iron ore price floor / China stimulus signals
Oil price trajectory and OPEC+ response
ANZ restructuring progress and bank credit data
Housing auction recovery or further decline
AUD/USD support levels and RBA intervention risk
watch_list: Brent crude – suppression failure and fuel pass-through
AUD/USD – growth scare and RBA signals
